summary: Iteration 10: Comprehensive testing of Authentication, Player Tiering, and Achievement Badges System. All 18 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing verified: registration flow, login with email/password, dashboard with tier display, profile page with achievements section, and game flow with TieredAvatar component.

authentication_flow: test_01_register_new_user - Registration creates user and sets session cookie
test_02_get_auth_me_after_register - /auth/me returns user data with player_tier, skill_rank
test_03_login_with_credentials - Login with email/password works correctly
player_tiering_system: test_06_new_user_starts_at_tier_1 - New users correctly start at tier 1
test_08_tier_in_game_state - Game state includes player_tier for both players
achievement_badges_api: test_10_get_my_achievements_authenticated - GET /api/achievements/me returns user's earned achievements
achievement_awarding: test_13_play_game_and_check_achievements - Game completion triggers achievement checks
achievement_structure: test_16_login_existing_user - Existing user achievements can be retrieved
test_17_achievement_categories - All 7 categories present (milestone, streak, skill, rating, challenge, club, special)
test_18_achievement_icons - All 20 achievements have valid icons
frontend_ui_tests: Registration page - Form fields work, redirects to onboarding
Login page - Email/password login works, redirects to dashboard
Dashboard - Shows Ball Knowledge score, tier badge, YOUR RANK section, Club Challenge
Profile page - Shows avatar with tier badge, Ball Knowledge, Credits, Achievements section (0/20), Game History, Top Players
Game page - TieredAvatar shows tier badges for both players, category selection works, question answering works, bot play works

critical_code_review_comments: Achievement system is well-implemented with 20 different achievements across 7 categories
TieredAvatar component correctly displays tier badges with color gradients based on tier level
Profile page correctly shows achievements count (0/20) and 'No achievements yet' message for users without achievements
seed_data_creation: Created new test users during backend testing with unique emails

authentication.registration: Working - creates user, sets session cookie, redirects to onboarding
authentication.login: Working - email/password authentication, session cookie set
authentication.session_validation: /auth/me returns user data with all fields including player_tier

player_tiering.tier_calculation: calculate_tier() function correctly calculates tier from total_game_points
player_tiering.tier_display_dashboard: Tier badge shown next to avatar in header (green circle with number)
player_tiering.tier_display_profile: TieredAvatar component shows tier badge on profile page
player_tiering.tier_display_game: Both players show tier badges during game (You: tier 4, Bot: tier 1)

api_endpoints.GET /api/achievements: Returns all 20 achievements with id, name, description, icon, category
api_endpoints.GET /api/achievements/me: Returns user's earned achievements with earned_at timestamp

achievement_badges.profile_display: Achievements section shows count (0/20) and grid of earned badges with icons
achievement_badges.game_over_display: Game over screen shows achievements_earned with badge icons and descriptions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 tested authentication, player tiering, and achievement badges. All backend APIs pass (18/18). Authentication flow works: registration → onboarding → dashboard, login → dashboard. Player tier is displayed on dashboard header, profile page, and game screen via TieredAvatar component. Achievement badges API returns 20 achievements across 7 categories. Profile page shows achievements section with count and earned badges. Game over screen shows achievements_earned. Use testuser@quizball.com / Test12345 for testing (tier 4, 1025 Ball Knowledge).
